name: Standard Meeting Minutes
description: General weekly / review meetings, with decisions and an action-item table

sections.title: Summary
sections.instruction: 3-5 sentences covering the meeting purpose and the overall conclusion

sections.title: Discussion Points
sections.instruction: Group by topic, keep key numbers, disagreements and the reasoning behind trade-offs

sections.title: Key Decisions
sections.instruction: List decisions that were actually made, each with its rationale

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: Markdown table: Owner | Task | Due | Timestamp in recording

sections.title: Risks and Open Questions
sections.instruction: Unresolved issues, dependencies, and anything needing escalation
